segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Hi there, how are you feeling now after the surgery?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Meh, still a bit groggy lah, but manageable. Got some pain here and there.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Can you rate your pain on a scale of 0 to 10? And where exactly is it hurting?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Around 4 or 5, mostly at the incision sites. Also got some gas pain here, like under my ribs.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Any nausea or vomiting? Feeling sick to your stomach?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: A bit queasy, but not throwing up. Throat also sore, like someone stuck a pipe down there.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Breathing okay? Any shortness of breath or wheezing?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Breathing fine, but throat still uncomfortable. Like heartburn burning, but not too bad.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Do you remember anything from the operation itself?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Nope, everything black out until now. Good thing, I guess!

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Any dizziness, chest pain, or headaches from your blood pressure or cholesterol?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Blood pressure been okay, no chest pain. Just the usual heartburn, but I’ll take my meds later.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Alright, we’ll keep monitoring you. Let the nurse know if pain or nausea gets worse, okay?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Sure thing, doc. Thanks for checking on me.
